milestones.label: Application deadline (set by each partner university, no single ADB date)
milestones.source_text: ADB's official pages say candidates apply to the partner university, which sets its own deadline, and papers should reach it at least six months before the intake. Example from a university page: Nagoya University GSID took ADB-JSP applications for April 2027 from 1 to 16 June 2026.
